description: 🆕 The feasibility check before you ask a user for money: which fiat-in and cash-out rails Coinbase actually runs in a country, the currencies and min/max limits for each, and how many assets across which networks. Distinguishes a country with card rails from one where crypto can only be transferred in — a difference most integrations discover only after a user fails. 122 countries covered.
